line: Got sticks at home and I still play VALORANT
vault_lines: Got sticks at home and I still play VALORANT
meaning:
“Sticks” is common slang meaning guns.

D-Block is stating that he has guns in his residence, but he still plays VALORANT which is a competitive first-person-shooter game developed and published by RIOT (known primarily for creating the immensely popular MOBA; League of Legends).

D-Block is stating despite him earning wealth that allows and requires him to own guns, that he still engages in activities he enjoyed prior to his rise to fame.
